workflows.name: Select the application template
workflows.statement: Select the application template using the URL, stored template, site setting and default in precedence order.

workflows.name: Start or resume from Home
workflows.statement: Start application opens the Membership page. Continue application opens the resume flow.

workflows.name: Resolve the next participating application page
workflows.statement: Resolve the next page using the page resolver or participating application order.

workflows.name: Advance the route or single-page section after save
workflows.statement: After successful continuation, advance the route or single-page section with transition feedback.

workflows.name: Show the selected entry notice before Start
workflows.statement: When the effective Site enables the Home entry notice, display its selected title and text before starting a new application. Cancel or dismissal stays on Home; Continue starts the application and opens Membership. A disabled notice does not interrupt Start. In single-page presentation the existing View notice action displays the same content without starting again.
workflows.source: src/pages/Home.tsx; requirements/parked/home.json; current optional notice behavior
